budget.scope: one continuous optimizer/replay/sampler process; ancestor updates are provenance only

data_lineage.conversion: O1 joint reorder and root local angular velocity to world; no recenter/resample/filter

semantics.collection_windows: All 33002 windows cover every collected real transition exactly once. Each window is assigned to a diagnostic interval by its ending joint-update count; milestone boundaries can differ by at most one log window.
semantics.losses: 33001 snapshots of the last joint update at logging time, not every optimizer update. WM loss is mean across that joint phase's 10 minibatches, critic loss mean across 20 critic minibatches.
semantics.return: Policy/reward=(dense_return+bootstrap_return)/(H*dt), H=32, dt=.02; not normalized formal R and not model-only mean reward.
semantics.raw_real_reward: sum(real_rewards)/real_transition_count/.1 is a transition-weighted train statistic under adaptive random-phase resets and 10s episode cap, not clip-macro full-motion evaluation.
semantics.gradients: Policy/grad_norm is total norm BEFORE max_norm=1 clipping and per-element .1 clipping. No WM/critic gradient norms or actual step norms logged.
semantics.reset_groups: Reset counts by selected reference clip; categories partition resets, named skills can overlap. Not transition allocation or success counts.
semantics.optimizer_defaults: Published optimizer_metadata records only class and LR. Does not record weight_decay, momentum, eps, or weight/parameter norms; default-decay evidence requires independent exact source/library verification.
semantics.causality: No unique root cause proved by correlated trajectories. O4 defeats the hypothesis that fixed5e-5 alone prevents long-run regression, not evidence that every official implementation fails.
